verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs say users see 'cost per run' out of the box, which covers per-request cost, and the CLI docs confirm a dashboard with analytics. Nothing documents token usage or breakdowns by model or time period. Missing for 10: token usage tracking, per-model cost/usage breakdown, time-period aggregation in dashboards, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI: triage issues, read runs, inspect signals, pull analytics.
